policy.action_definition: Compute p_i=(1-gamma)w_i/sumw+gamma/K and deterministically sort p_i; update every arm w_i*=exp(gamma*bounded_delta_i/(K*max(p_i,1e-12))).
policy.counter_definition: The native reward agent computes reward_function.evaluate(metric, last_prioritization) and adds each rank-aligned credit to that current name's cumulative ValueEstimates V. Missing joined credit adds zero. Every ranked name receives an ActionAttempts increment from numpy.linspace(1.0, 1e-12, ranking_length), so ActionAttempts N is fractional rank exposure, including unscheduled names, not selected-arm pulls. The agent increments t once per observe before policy credit_assignment; t is a logical observation count, not elapsed time or number of choose calls. For every current action on each credit_assignment, the policy subtracts its stored previous cumulative V (default zero) from current V, then stores current V. The bounded delta is the unchanged finite delta when 0<=delta<=1; non-finite delta maps to 0; other finite deltas map to 0.5*(tanh(delta)+1). Thus a valid negative delta maps to a positive transformed credit rather than being clipped to zero. All current actions receive updates, with no chosen-action indicator. For each current name, pre-update mass p_i=(1-gamma)*w_i/sum_current(w)+gamma/K, with K=current action count. Its positive weight multiplies by exp(gamma*bounded_delta/(K*max(p_i,1e-12))). Ranking sorts p_i without sampling and Q receives the pre-update p_i; these masses are not logged action propensities.
policy.guidance: Preserve this explicitly native CI ranking recipe. Generic sampled choice, selected subsets, observed pairwise feedback, calibrated probabilities and independent recipe mixtures need their own qualified implementations; never infer them from this name.

lifecycle.checkpoint_definition: The 37-name mechanical dispatch fixture disabled native restore/checkpoints. No all-policy ordinary pickle or global-RNG recovery guarantee follows.
lifecycle.discovery: Current agent rows drop retired names and append sorted new names; contextual update_actions has its own context setup/re-entry path. No generic identity/version mapping is performed.
lifecycle.reset: Agent.reset zeros current ValueEstimates/ActionAttempts/Q, last ranking and t, but retains action names, policy object/state, agent RNG and caches; window history is not cleared. Environment reset is not fresh construction or RNG rewind.
lifecycle.retirement: policy dictionaries and last cumulative-value baseline retain retired names; setdefault reuses old state on re-entry. Agent rows still drop/reset independently.
lifecycle.sharing: Factory creates one policy object for each named policy/reward recipe; agent rows and policy RNG lifetime follow their explicit owners.

reward.coverage: Ranking-aligned native learning credit computed from the supplied budgeted metric. Zero for an unscheduled/uncredited position is not evidence of an executed passing test, full observed alternatives or a defined bounded loss. All actual metric/index assumptions remain native.
reward.formula: Per returned ranking position i, emit1 if i+1 is in metric.detection_ranks, otherwise0; when no detection ranks emit an all-zero vector. Rank indices are metric scheduled ranks, not newly observed outcomes.
